intended_object: An auxiliary open set in ℝ² used inside the NaturalProfile construction: {p | |Λ·p.1| < 20 and -11/10 < p.2 < 11/10}. I read this off the body and the docstring, which only restates the formula.
explanation: The definition takes the preimage, under the rescaling (x, y) ↦ (Λx, y), of the rectangle `AxisEvaluation.strip window 20 = Ioo (-20) 20 ×ˢ Ioo (-11/10) (11/10)`. The constants are hard-coded: 20 for the width and the window (-11/10, 11/10), which is chosen to contain [-1, 1]. Together with the rescaling, these show it is a technical working domain set up for estimates in this particular Navier–Stokes profile argument. It is not a standard mathematical object with a counterpart in the literature or in Mathlib. The docstring just restates the formula and does not name any mathematical concept. So this is an auxiliary construction for a proof.
